outcome: magnesium sulfate use for convulsion management
cohort: Women who delivered at Gandhi Memorial Hospital in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, from September 1, 2017 to August 31, 2018.
finding: The prevalence of eclampsia was 6.2%, with high maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: 47.8% of women who required pregnancy termination by induction underwent cesarean section due to non-reassuring fetal status (29.2%).
